card.name: Linking words before lithium toxicity or risks
card.fires_on: The small word "for" after "monitor patients" or "evaluate patients" in NSAID and lithium interaction text, just before "signs of lithium toxicity". It also fires on similar linking words before a named risk.

modes.label: The phrase about monitoring patients for a risk
modes.description: The word "for" after monitor or evaluate patients in the NSAID-lithium interaction line.
modes.example: During concomitant use of OXAPROZIN CAPSULES and lithium, monitor patients<< for>> signs of lithium toxicity.

modes.label: Other linking words before risks
modes.description: "of", "and" or "cause" just before a named risk or toxicity in warnings.
modes.example: Females of reproductive potential must be aware<< of>> these risks and must be counseled
